test_cases.test_case_title: Student Asks Question via Chat and Requests to Speak in Video Session
test_cases.pre_condition: A student user is successfully logged in to the 'FullTeaching' system and has joined an active video session for the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course. The teacher is also present in the session.
test_cases.expected_result: The student's chat message 'valid_chat_message_content' is successfully sent and appears in the chat interface. The student's request to speak is successfully initiated and displayed to the teacher for intervention. The system maintains an active video session.
test_cases.post_condition: The student has sent a chat message and requested to speak in the active video session.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the 'Chat Interface' on the '2.1.1.4 SC-006: Video Session Screen'
Click the 'Send Message' button in the chat interface

test_cases.groups_involved: End Video Session, Open Side Menu, Send Chat Message, Request to Speak, Grant Student Intervention

test_cases.test_case_title: Student Asks Question via Chat and Requests Intervention in Live Session - Unsuccessful Send Chat Message
test_cases.pre_condition: A student named 'student_newuser' with email 'student_newuser@example.com' is successfully logged in and has joined a live video session for the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course, which is currently active and being led by a teacher. The chat interface and 'Ask for Intervention' button are visible and interactive.
test_cases.expected_result: The student attempts to send a chat message, but the message is not sent due to invalid message data. An error message is displayed in the chat interface indicating the failure, and the student's intervention request is not denied.
test_cases.post_condition: The student remains in the video session. No chat message is successfully sent. The system displays an error message related to the invalid chat message.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the 'Students' tab on the Course Details page.
Click the session link for the 'Introduction to Software Testing' session.
Ensure the main video player displays the teacher or presenting student's video stream.
Attempt to send 'null' as a message in the 'Chat Interface' field.

test_cases.groups_involved: End Video Session, Open Side Menu, Send Chat Message, Request to Speak, Grant Student Intervention

test_cases.test_case_title: Student Sends Whitespace-Only Chat Message in Video Session
test_cases.pre_condition: A student user 'student_newuser@example.com' is logged in and has successfully joined a live video session for the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course, which was previously initiated by a teacher.
test_cases.expected_result: The system should prevent the transmission of the whitespace-only chat message and not display it in the chat interface, indicating a validation failure for the message data. The student will be notified that the message is invalid, and no message will be added to the chat.
test_cases.post_condition: The student remains in the live video session. The chat interface has not displayed the whitespace-only message.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course in the Course List to navigate to the Course Details Page
Click on the active session link to join the video session
Enter '   ' into the 'Chat Interface' text area
Click the 'Send Message' button in the chat interface

test_cases.groups_involved: End Video Session, Open Side Menu, Send Chat Message, Request to Speak, Grant Student Intervention
